CErc20Delegator constructor: sets admin=msg.sender, delegatecalls initialize on implementation, then _setImplementation, then admin=admin_
_setImplementation(address,bool,bytes) public; admin-only setter that delegatecalls _resignImplementation/_becomeImplementation and updates implementation
delegateTo(address callee, bytes data) internal; performs raw delegatecall and assembly revert on failure
delegateToImplementation(bytes data) public; forwards data to delegateTo(implementation, data)
delegateToViewImplementation(bytes data) public view; staticcalls self delegateToImplementation and abi.decodes result
delegateToViewAndReturn() private view; staticcalls self delegateToImplementation with msg.data and raw-returns returndata
delegateAndReturn() private; delegatecalls implementation with msg.data and raw-returns returndata
fallback function payable; rejects value and delegates every unknown call to delegateAndReturn
